control_probe.latency_attribution: The 576-record delayed segment starts 1.280s before first SDK USB error and continues 5.730s after. It references physical wheel containers already received 100-1023ms earlier, while its maximum consecutive probe-receive gap is only 68.9ms. Ordinary-priority probe scheduling alone cannot explain the full one-second lag. Delay is present in the motion support selected at publication or upstream observer/forwarding/processing. Existing logs have no processing timestamps at each intermediate hop, so they do not isolate UART-relay observer vs chassis queue vs MotionInbox vs worker work/GIL. No unsupported precise CPU/root-cause claim.
control_probe.consumer_scheduling: Ordinary scheduling in this diagnostic probe, unlike the formal control output FIFO10 thread; no per-stage timing proves a precise attribution.

sessions.interpretation: FAILED/incomplete joint-load run: 3 startup motion-input drops plus T265 USB IO/NO_DEVICE and camera allocation failure. Later true SDK returns are not delivery/fusion evidence; no physical precision or hard-real-time conclusion.

conclusions: 033238/033424 establish restored real F405 plus ~100Hz host SDK input under initialisation/normal numerical load; raw Pose ~200Hz and zero motion-input drops in those sessions.

033738 is separately failed: startup input overflow, cessation of raw Pose and USB IO/NO_DEVICE, camera allocation failure. Host SDK bool remains true afterward, illustrating absence of per-sample device ACK.
Control probe mostly exercises existing wheel fallback, not a successful full healthy YOLO/T265/lidar joint chain.
No movement or independent field measurement: none of these sessions proves field precision or strict every-10ms delivery.
Lidar CRC/timing/sector counters match historical source; chassis raw offline CRC parsing stays separate.

Failed third run reveals a real host wheel-receive-to-control-probe tail up to1.023s in one576-record segment. This is not explained away by unknown MCU time quality; its stage/root cause remains to be isolated. It must not be hidden by an overall ~100Hz SDK bool-return count.
